Gold Coin 3D Model
(Finance 0002)
It is a gold coin. It can be used to represent a fiat coin of certain currencies.

This model has 700 tris.

The zip contains
1) a Blender file
2) a FBX file
3) a glTF file
4) a preview image
5) a folder of 4k texture maps
